title: The Milkmaid and Her Pail
source: Aesop's Fables (public domain), gently retold for bedtime

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Once upon a time, on a little farm at the edge of a green valley, there lived a young milkmaid called Molly.
lines.speech: [warm, smiling storytelling] Once upon a time, on a little farm at the edge of a green valley, there lived a young milkmaid [delighted] called Molly!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every morning, she milked Buttercup, the gentle brown cow, while the hens clucked and the sun came up over the hills.
lines.speech: [cheerful storytelling] Every morning, she milked Buttercup, the gentle brown cow, [playful] while the hens clucked, and the sun came up over the hills!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: Good morning, Buttercup! What lovely creamy milk you've given me today.
lines.speech: [delighted, giggles] Good morning, Buttercup! [amazed] What lovely, creamy milk you've given me today!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Molly's mother gave her a kind smile.
lines.speech: [warmly, with a twinkle] Molly's mother gave her a kind smile.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Take the milk to market, my dear. Whatever you earn, you may keep.
lines.speech: [tender, smiling] Take the milk to market, my dear! [playful] Whatever you earn, you may keep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Molly set the pail of milk upon her head, and off she went, down the winding country lane.
lines.speech: [playful storytelling] So Molly set the pail of milk upon her head, and off she went, [cheerful] down the winding country lane!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And as she walked, she began to dream.
lines.speech: [storytelling, full of wonder] And as she walked, [delighted] she began to dream!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: With the money from this milk, I'll buy some eggs.
lines.speech: [dreamy, then suddenly excited] With the money from this milk, I'll buy some eggs!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: The eggs will hatch into fluffy little chicks. And the chicks will grow into fine, fat hens!
lines.speech: [excited] The eggs will hatch into fluffy little chicks! [more excited, giggles] And the chicks will grow into fine, fat hens!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: I'll sell the hens, and buy a beautiful new dress. A blue one, with ribbons!
lines.speech: [very excited, delighted] I'll sell the hens, and buy a beautiful new dress! [amazed] A blue one, with ribbons!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: And when I wear it to the fair, everyone will look at me. And I'll just toss my head, like this!
lines.speech: [excited, giggling] And when I wear it to the fair, everyone will look at me! [proudly, with a playful giggle] And I'll just toss my head — like this!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Molly tossed her head. Splash! Down came the pail, and all the milk spilled out onto the lane.
lines.speech: [playful storytelling] And Molly tossed her head... [gasps] Splash! [dismayed] Down came the pail, and all the milk spilled out onto the lane.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: Oh no! The milk... and the eggs, and the chicks, and the hens, and my blue dress. All gone!
lines.speech: [gasps] Oh no! [dismayed] The milk... [rising dismay] and the eggs, and the chicks, and the hens, and my blue dress! [sighs sadly] All gone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Molly walked slowly home, with her empty pail, and told her mother what had happened.
lines.speech: [sympathetic storytelling] Molly walked slowly home, with her empty pail, and told her mother what had happened.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Oh, my darling. Never mind. But remember, don't count your chickens before they are hatched.
lines.speech: [chuckles warmly] Oh, my darling. Never mind. [tender] But remember, don't count your chickens before they are hatched.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: I'll remember, Mother. One step at a time.
lines.speech: [giggles] I'll remember, Mother! [sighs happily] One step at a time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That evening, the sun set softly over the valley, and Buttercup lay down in the warm straw.
lines.speech: [warm, happy storytelling] That evening, the sun set softly over the valley, and Buttercup lay down in the warm straw.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The hens tucked their heads under their wings, and Molly curled up in her little bed by the window.
lines.speech: [warm, smiling storytelling] The hens tucked their heads under their wings, and Molly curled up in her little bed by the window.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And as the stars came out, she dreamed, not of dresses and fairs, but of tomorrow's sunny morning, one step at a time.
lines.speech: [tender storytelling] And as the stars came out, she dreamed, not of dresses and fairs, but of tomorrow's sunny morning, [sighs happily] one step at a time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Goodnight, little one. Sweet dreams.
lines.speech: [whispers] Goodnight, little one... [whispers] Sweet dreams.
